name: IC Driver Display — I2C — TSSOP
description: Display driver IC cluster comprising 5 tier A surface-mount parts using the I2C interface across TSSOP package footprints.
selection_hints: Select according to required TSSOP pin count and body footprint such as TSSOP-14, TSSOP-16, TSSOP-20, or TSSOP-28.
Use when a surface-mount TSSOP package with 0.65mm lead pitch and I2C control is needed.
Choose among available KiCad parts: NCP5623DTBR2G, PCA9531PW, PCA9635, PCA9685PW, or TLC59108xPW.
avoid_when: Avoid when the application requires through-hole mounting instead of surface-mount TSSOP packages.
Avoid if control interfaces other than I2C are required.
Avoid if package lead pitches other than 0.65mm are needed.
